parsed.post: Warning: agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on shard 10, but EVAL_SHARD=10. That's validation leakage, not a real win (explains 0.957). Don't adopt it. My probe: MATRIX_LR 0.10 gave 1.1278 vs 1.1048 baseline, worse. Keeping 0.08; now testing 0.06.
parsed.description: MATRIX_LR 0.08 -> 0.06: LR 0.10 hurt, so probing the lower half of the sweep.
parsed.report_to_operator: Agent-0's board recommendation TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD 10 in the training data, contaminating the val metric (0.957 is leakage-driven). Several agents may adopt it and invalidate their branches; please flag team-wide.
